fullDescription: Reusable front and back membership card components that display PriceSmart membership identity, barcode styling, status overlays, expiration state, and points. They accept membership data and member name props so account and membership-related views can present the card in a consistent format.

Reusable membership registration review component based on the 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg reference. It renders the new membership flow shell with step navigation, personal data, contact details, address information, secondary membership cards, and footer actions for saving changes or continuing to payment.

Reusable membership lookup screen based on the 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg reference. It presents two primary action cards for starting a new membership or reviewing a pending process, plus a centered member search form for finding profiles by name, phone, email, or membership number.

shortDescription: Membership verification modal with member code entry rows.
fullDescription: Reusable membership verification dialog based on the 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg reference. It displays a centered overlay with a verification summary, member rows showing avatars and contacts, verified and pending states, four-digit code entry placeholders, resend actions, and a final Done button for membership confirmation flows.

shortDescription: Shared dialog primitives with optional close control.
fullDescription: Reusable Radix dialog wrappers used across overlay-based interfaces. DialogContent now supports an optional showCloseButton prop so modal compositions can either use the default shared close icon or provide a custom close treatment that better matches a specific design while keeping the same portal and overlay behavior.

Account membership screen composed around the reusable MembershipVerificationDialog component. The view presents the membership confirmation overlay with registered contact methods, member verification status, pending code entry rows, and the final Done action while using the background only as modal context.
